title: Application and service hosting
requirement: Run a local typed application and supporting services reproducibly while keeping accounts, state and deployment scope explicit.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Choose deployment requirements first: local development, remote service or GPU job. Qualify one host/container option on data, network, rollback, persistence and measured workload cost.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
